title: Curriculum Assessment v1
description: Schema for curricula used with the Curriculum Self-Assessment Tool. A curriculum consists of learning goals grouped into lessons, assessed against a rating scale and relevance levels. Constraints that cannot be expressed in pure JSON Schema are documented in the accompanying schema documentation.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Must equal 'curriculum-assessment/1' for this version. Forward-incompatible changes will use a new identifier (e.g. 'curriculum-assessment/2').

scale.description: Rating scale used for self-assessment. Typical: 5 points from 'unknown' to 'can teach'. All scale[].value must be unique within the scale.

levels.description: Relevance levels that define the expected proficiency per goal. For iSAQB typically R1/R2/R3, but any codes are allowed. All levels[].code must be unique within the array.

lessons.description: Learning goals grouped into lessons. Lessons are presented to users in array order.

meta.description: Curriculum metadata. Shown in the tool UI and the generated report.

version.description: Optional version of the curriculum itself (e.g. '1.6.1-EN'). Independent of the schema version.

source.description: Optional URL to the original source of the curriculum.

language.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag for the content language (e.g. 'de', 'en', 'en-GB').

description.description: Optional longer description shown in list views.

value.description: Numeric value of this scale point. Typically sequential (1, 2, 3, ...). Unique within the scale.

short.description: Short label used in buttons and tight spaces.

full.description: Optional longer description used in the introduction screen.

code.description: Unique identifier for this level. Referenced by goal.level. Convention: short uppercase (R1, K2, EXPERT).

expected.description: Minimum scale value required to consider this level 'reached'. Goals rated below this are flagged as gaps in the assessment.

description.description: Optional longer explanation of what this level requires.

number.description: Lesson number. Should be unique within the curriculum and typically sequential.

goals.description: Learning goals contained in this lesson.

goal.description: A single learning goal. Additional properties are allowed for tool-specific extensions but may be ignored by the reference implementation.

id.description: Unique identifier for this goal across the entire curriculum. Used to track ratings and referenced in reports. Convention: 'LG <lesson>-<index>' (e.g. 'LG 1-1').

level.description: Relevance level for this goal. Must exactly match one of the level.code values defined in the top-level 'levels' array.

title.description: Short, action-oriented title of the goal (e.g. 'Gründe für Software-Änderungen kennen und erklären').

description.description: Optional 1–2 sentence framing. Answers the question: why does this goal matter?

topics.description: Optional list of sub-topics covered by this goal. Rendered as a bullet list.

example.description: Optional concrete example scenario that makes the goal tangible. Newlines (\n) are rendered as line breaks by the reference implementation.

effortHours.description: Optional estimated learning effort for this goal, in hours. Used to compute total curriculum effort and the effort needed to close assessed gaps.
